Mistress '''Miaxi''', a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], was a former [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] who became consort to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial governor (Speco)|governor]] of [[Speco]]. Miaxi was said to have ran the [[Speco system/Legends|system]] by using her Falleen charms on the enthralled [[Governor/Legends|governor]].
